title: basic automerge
script:
-- consider joining my discord ! https://discord.gg/v235R3HrCQ
game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.ClientGui.SystemMessageFrame:Destroy()
while wait(2) do
for i,v in pairs(game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.ClientGui.SavedElementsFrame.ElementsScrollingFrame:GetChildren()) do
    if v:IsA("TextButton") then
    local args = {
	v.Name,
	Vector2.new(30.767597198486328, -317.9511413574219)
    }
    game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("InsertElement"):FireServer(unpack(args))
    
    end
    wait(.2)
end
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("what"):InvokeServer()

end

game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("InsertElement"):FireServer(unpack(args))
